# Fanfarr v0.5.23

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why.

## Bulk lengths, confirmed applies, and small accessibility wins

The library's bulk bar grows a Lengths action: set the crop length and the
fifteen-minute duration cap for the whole selection at once, or clear the
length back to the global target. Same synchronous shape as Exclude -- fields,
so badges change now rather than after a job nobody asked for.

Applying themes asks first now, on the bulk bar and on Overview's Apply all --
through the same native confirm the backup delete uses. A Plex upload cannot be
undone, so one dialog is the whole safety story.

Smaller findings from the same design pass: a Custom Ns badge by the item
title when a per-title length is set, Escape closing both library dialogs, and
coverage bars that expose their values as progressbars instead of silent divs.

## Dependency refresh

oban, ash_oban, ash_phoenix, ash_sql, ash_sqlite, ecto_sqlite3, exqlite,
esbuild and tailwind move within their constraints. ash_sqlite 0.3 wants a
minimum SQLite version declared on the repo, pinned to the bundled 3.54.1.
Lucide renamed icons again (music, both alerts, and bold is gone); the icon
test caught all of it.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on boot.
